Uganda content gap analysis · cycle 2026-09

All 6,765 Uganda articles in cebwiki, and what they are about

cebwiki holds more Uganda articles than any other Wikipedia edition, including English. 2 of them are biographies. This page lists every one so that claim can be checked rather than taken on trust.

Every row is generated from the same database as the dashboard. The edition shown is whichever one ranks first this cycle, so this page follows the ranking rather than naming an edition in advance. Back to the findings.

Every article

Sorted so the biographies come first, then by how many language editions carry the topic. Titles link to cebwiki. 58 of these reached the corpus only through a weak retrieval strategy and are marked accordingly: they are why a Uganda list can contain a country or a head of state who is not Ugandan. 1,571 of them carry no English label in Wikidata at all, which is its own signal of how they were created.

Method. The corpus is Wikidata items about Uganda carrying at least one Wikipedia sitelink; this page is the subset with a sitelink to cebwiki. Category is assigned by substring-matching the item's Wikidata type labels, which is approximate: an airport lands in “everything else” rather than in institutions, for instance. Counts here match the dashboard because both use the same rule.

Article text and titles from Wikipedia (CC BY-SA), structured data from Wikidata (CC0). Rebuild with python src_viz/export_data.py then python src_viz/build_pages.py.
